text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] SEV2 — EU-west latency spike + increased 5xx rate. Smart-routing policy 'cost_vs_latency' recently adjusted (rollout id: roll-2026-03-15-07). Paging on-call.

Carmen (SRE): I see a big shift to economy lane for long seqs in eu-west, 95th latency doubled, errors spiking ~12%. Some heavy tail coming from org-123 and org-789.

Liam (oncall): on it. Are we sure it’s routing policy and not infra? graphs show node CPU OK, memory fine.

Serena (infra): infra looks healthy. NVidia GPU util normal. KV cache hit rates dropped for eu-west (likely mismatched model variant).

Nate (prod-eng): we recently pushed a cost_vs_latency tweak to favor economy lane for non-prem tiers — rollout id matches. Suggest immediate mitigation: stop steering new traffic to economy lane for EU and enforce stricter rate limits for economy.

Carmen (SRE): agreed. Steps I propose: 1) Add temporary per-org quota throttles for org-123/org-789. 2) Shift smart-routing weights: EU-west -> prefer latency_lane (priority) until healthy. 3) Reduce economy lane burst capacity to 10r/s.

Liam (oncall): do we have the CLI commands for the policy change?

Serena (infra): use the routing-service patch:

```bash
# set weight for policy cost_vs_latency in eu-west region
redwoodctl routing patch --policy cost_vs_latency --region eu-west --set weight_latency=0.85 --set weight_cost=0.15 --rollout-id emergency-eu-2143
```

Carmen (SRE): applying throttle for org-123 and org-789 now:

```bash
redwoodctl quota set --org org-123 --region eu-west --rps 15 --reason "emergency throttles due to routing surge"
redwoodctl quota set --org org-789 --region eu-west --rps 10 --reason "emergency throttles due to routing surge"
```

ops-bot: ACTION: routing update in progress (rollout emergency-eu-2143). Canary on 3 nodes.

Liam (oncall): Carmen, when canary finishes, increase canary to 20% then full? please confirm rollback plan.

Carmen (SRE): Canary succeeded on first two nodes, but one node returned transient 502s during kernel coldstart — holding at 20% while we watch error rates. Rollback plan: revert routing patch and quotas to previous rollout id roll-2026-03-15-07 if errors >5% sustained for 5m.

Nate (prod-eng): additionally, enable immediate fallback: requests that hit economy lane and exceed 100ms queue -> fallback to latency_lane variant. Patch:

```json
{"policy":"cost_vs_latency","fallback":{"threshold_ms":100,"target":"latency_lane"}}
```

Serena (infra): I've pushed fallback policy to the edge for EU. Observability: latency p95 started dropping after canary expansion from 2100ms -> 980ms. Errors down from +12% -> +4%.

Liam (oncall): good. Customer impact? any active incidents reported?

Carmen (SRE): PagerDuty shows 13 alerts, top 3 orgs: org-123 (600 req/min), org-456 (300 req/min), org-789 (250 req/min). We throttled two of them. Estimated impacted requests reduced to ~250/min after throttles. High-value customers: org-456 unaffected so far.

Nate (prod-eng): Runbook note: when toggling weights, short term token cost will increase but preserves p95 and reduces errors — acceptable tradeoff for now.

Liam (oncall): I'm going to notify Support & CS to prepare messaging to org-123/org-789. Carmen, leave notes here for handoff.

Carmen (SRE): Hand-off checklist:
- Mitigations applied: routing weight patch (emergency-eu-2143), per-org throttles for org-123/org-789, fallback rule enabled.
- Observed impact: p95 eu-west 2100ms -> 980ms; error rate 12% -> 4% in 8m window.
- Rollback trigger: sustained error >5% for 5m or canary fail on >2 nodes.
- Owners: Carmen (SRE) initial, Liam (oncall) will drive next 30m, Nate available for code fixes.
- Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/traffic-mitigation

ops-bot: NOTE: quota changes logged to audit (evt id q-2143654321).

Liam (oncall): I'll stay on the thread for the next 30m and then hand off to Nate for overnight. If anything degrades, escalate to SEV1 and page infra-leads.

Serena (infra): also recommended: re-evaluate model-variant pinning for economy lane — caching mismatch may be the root cause. I'll open a follow-up PR after stable.

Carmen (SRE): leaving a short debugging log snippet:

```text
2026-03-15T07:02:13Z eu-west node-12 routing decision: cost_vs_latency -> economy_lane (weight 0.75) cache_miss true model_variant v2-q8 error 502
2026-03-15T07:04:27Z eu-west node-09 routing decision: cost_vs_latency -> latency_lane (weight 0.85) cache_hit true model_variant v2-q8 ok
```

Nate (prod-eng): I'll pick this up after Liam signs off. Add me to the incident retro.

Liam (oncall): Thanks all. Leaving handoff now — monitoring for 10 more minutes. If stable, I'll mark mitigation complete and open an ops follow-up to revert emergency throttles in 2 hours.

incident-bot: Incident thread marked 'monitored' — remind in 2h for debrief.

PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by Liam (oncall).
